description: This file contains utility functions for implementing the game logic of a 2048 puzzle game, including grid creation, cloning, tile addition, move validation, and move execution.

methods.name: createEmptyGrid
methods.description: Creates an empty 4x4 grid represented as a 2D array filled with nulls.

methods.name: cloneGrid
methods.description: Performs a deep clone of the grid, copying each cell object.

methods.name: addRandomTile
methods.description: Adds a new tile with value 2 or 4 at a random empty position on the grid.

methods.name: movesAvailable
methods.description: Checks if there are any valid moves left, either by empty cells or mergeable tiles.

methods.name: has2048
methods.description: Determines if the grid contains a tile with value 2048 or higher.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Executes a move in one of four directions ('left', 'right', 'up', 'down') and returns the new grid state, score delta, move status, and merge IDs.
